# Al-Misbah Institute

> Humanitarian NGO in Pakistan providing clean water, education, emergency relief, and community development with transparent, sponsorable projects.

- Website: https://www.almisbahinstitute.com/
- Organization: Al-Misbah Institute (also known as Al-Misbah Center)
- Location: Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
- Founded: 2025
- Contact: info@almisbah.org

## What we do

- Hand pump installation and clean drinking water programs
- Quran Hifz schools and Islamic education support
- Flood relief and emergency humanitarian aid
- Community development initiatives across Pakistan

- Home: https://www.almisbahinstitute.com/

## For donors

Supporters can sponsor specific project options online (checkout) or donate via bank transfer. Registration and project updates are shared for transparency.
